channel.title: Onchain Brief
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, security incidents, regulation and new blockchain networks.

item.title: SEC proposes new custody paths for crypto advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed new custody options for advisers and funds holding some crypto assets, including limited self-custody and state trust companies.

item.title: How LP fronting gets tokens to another chain sooner
item.description: LP fronting lets a provider send tokens on the destination chain first, then recover funds after the source transfer settles; speed depends on liquidity, fees and settlement.

item.title: Poocoin: How to Compare Token Prices Across Trading Pairs
item.description: Poocoin can help compare BNB Smart Chain token prices, but a pair’s quote, liquidity and trade size all affect whether the displayed price is useful.

item.title: BaseSwap: Should You Swap Tokens or Add Liquidity?
item.description: A swap changes one token into another; a liquidity pool supplies tokens for other traders. Your goal, time frame and tolerance for price changes point to the better fit.

item.title: FCA opens crypto authorisation applications ahead of 2027 rules
item.description: The FCA has opened its crypto authorisation window, giving UK firms until 28 February 2027 to apply before wider rules take effect in October.
